com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Sneak Attack
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Once per turn, Idony deals an extra [1d6] damage when she has advantage or an ally is adjacent to the target.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Shortsword
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Melee Weapon Attack [1d20+4] to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. [1d6+2] piercing damage. Add [1d6] sneak attack if advantage or ally adjacent.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Dagger (thrown)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Ranged Weapon Attack [1d20+4] to hit, range 20/60 ft., one target. [1d4+2] piercing damage.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Bonus Action: Cunning Action
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Idony can take the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action as a bonus action.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Extra Attack
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Radek makes two attacks when he takes the Attack action.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Battle Master (3 Superiority Dice d8)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Uses Disarming Attack, Pushing Attack, and Trip Attack manoeuvres.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Action Surge (1/short rest)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Takes one additional action on his turn. Use when a player breaks through the bottleneck or on round 2 if the party is gaining ground.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trait: Fights for the Joy of It
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Fights with enjoyment, not efficiency. Last of his crew to go down, and not gracefully.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Longsword (x2)
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Melee Weapon Attack [1d20+5] to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. [1d8+3] slashing damage. Makes two attacks per Attack action.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Disarming Attack
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Expend one superiority die. On hit, target must succeed on DC 13 Str save or drop one held item. Add [1d8] to damage.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Trip Attack
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Expend one superiority die. On hit, target must succeed on DC 13 Str save or be knocked prone. Add [1d8] to damage.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Pushing Attack
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: Expend one superiority die. On hit, target must succeed on DC 13 Str save or be pushed 15 ft. away. Add [1d8] to damage.

com.battle-system.forge/Z035.name: Bonus Action: Intimidating Glare
com.battle-system.forge/Z035.description: One creature within 30 ft. that can see Radek makes a Wisdom (Insight) check contested by his Intimidation (+5). If Radek wins, the creature has disadvantage on its next attack roll against him.
